split_ratio: 60% dev / 40% test (approximate), stratified by question type (scripts/split_eval_questions.py)
evaluation_criterion: Hit = any retrieved chunk from the same source PDF whose page range overlaps the gold chunk's page range (src/sebisage/eval/retrieval_eval.py::overlaps) -- NOT a reg_no string match. Page overlap is used because the fixed-size baseline chunker never sets reg_no, and page overlap is stricter anyway (requires the specific sub-regulation/clause, not just any chunk from the right regulation).
annotator_note: Questions human-reviewed in Phase 3 via data/eval/review.html (checkpoint H3). Single annotator. 3 of 60 drafted questions were dropped in review (q015, q024, q040); 57 verified questions remain, split into dev (34) / test (23).
limitations: Small test set (n_answerable_test=21) -- bootstrap CIs are wide; treat as rough uncertainty estimates, not statistically precise CIs
Single annotator -- no inter-annotator agreement measure
Hit criterion is page-range overlap within the same source file, not reg_no match; still does not distinguish which specific clause within an overlapping page range was retrieved
Only 5 regulations indexed (LODR, PIT, SAST, IA, RA); circulars and master circulars are not indexed
Not a legal correctness evaluation -- measures retrieval and citation grounding, not whether the answer is legally correct or complete
